name: ATM Exception Acknowledgement V 02
definition: The ATMExceptionAcknowledgement message is sent by an acquirer or its agent to an ATM to acknowledge the receipt of an ATMExceptionAdvice message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMExceptionAcknowledgement.name: ATM Exception Acknowledgement
ATMExceptionAcknowledgement.definition: Information related to the acknowledgement of an ATM exception.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
